Business Administration

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

The Dutch-taught Bedrijfskunde degree studies how organisations function and change. It combines strategy, marketing, people, finance, economics, responsible enterprise and empirical organisational research.

The published credit structure is shown while conflicting official thesis-entry requirements are clarified. A complete UCR comparison is withheld; this does not mean that UCR has no relevant business programme.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Bedrijfskunde (Dutch-taught)

The 25 published components sum to 180 EC, but current official thesis-entry requirements conflict. This table shows the supported credit structure; it is not a certified complete degree pathway. UCR comparisons remain withheld pending authoritative clarification.

Official programme source ↗
Verified partial curriculum — incomplete degree pathway

Only the verified components listed below are shown. They do not constitute a complete degree programme.

External programme components

6 EC

Free-choice space
30 EC
30 EC of free choice in third-year semester 1. University courses, an 18-EC minor plus further courses, study abroad or an internship require approval and non-overlap. OER Article 17 permits 6, 12 or 24-EC internships; no internship or minor is compulsory.


Bachelor's Thesis in Business Administration
12 EC
The OER and current official course catalogue both require at least 102 EC, but name different prerequisite courses. Their controlling relationship needs authoritative clarification before this degree pathway can be certified.
